title: Student ID
description: Student identity credential carrying SCHAC and eduPerson attributes, issued as an SD-JWT VC (OpenID4VCI scope StudentID).

vct.description: Verifiable credential type identifier of the student ID.

identifier.description: Unique identifier of the student credential.

schacPersonalUniqueCode.description: SCHAC personal unique code of the student.

schacPersonalUniqueID.description: SCHAC personal unique ID of the student.

schacHomeOrganization.description: SCHAC identifier of the student's home organisation.

displayName.description: Name of the student as preferred for display.

dateOfBirth.description: Date of birth of the student.

eduPersonPrincipalName.description: eduPerson principal name (scoped identifier) of the student.

eduPersonPrimaryAffiliation.description: eduPerson primary affiliation of the student with the home organisation.

eduPersonAffiliation.description: eduPerson affiliation of the student with the home organisation.

eduPersonScopedAffiliation.description: eduPerson affiliation of the student, scoped to the home organisation domain.

eduPersonAssurance.description: eduPerson assurance profile that applies to the student's identity.
